description: This file defines the DittoLogger interface, an extension of SLF4J Logger with additional methods for managing correlation IDs via MDC, including setting, deriving from headers, and discarding correlation IDs.

classes.name: DittoLogger
classes.description: An interface extending SLF4J Logger with additional methods for correlation ID management, including setting, deriving from headers, and discarding correlation IDs.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID for the next log operation, discarding it automatically afterward.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Derives the correlation ID from WithDittoHeaders for the next log operation.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Derives the correlation ID from DittoHeaders for the next log operation.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID for all subsequent log operations until manually discarded.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Derives the correlation ID from WithDittoHeaders for all subsequent log operations until discarded.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Derives the correlation ID from DittoHeaders for all subsequent log operations until discarded.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the currently set correlation ID from the MDC.
